question: Which divine forms are to be beheld at this sacred site?
premises: Gokarṇa is present in bull-shaped form
Vikarṇa is present in man-shaped form
Both forms are objects of vision
inference: The site presents Gokarṇa as bull-shaped and Vikarṇa as man-shaped.
plain_english: One should see Gokarṇa in the form of a bull and Vikarṇa in the form of a man.
